mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where the UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations adjust downward.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a single month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investor confidence grows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% in a single month signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and economic activity improve.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2% each in a single month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment increase.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 0.2% and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where both PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a single month, coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decrease > 1% and UNRATE increase > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 1% and UNRATE increases by more than 0.3% in a month.
